context: Tests: environments, job summaries, always-run cleanup, public action version lookup and validation.

checklist.name: Environment declared
checklist.description: The deploy job declares `environment: production` so approvals and history apply.

checklist.name: Deploy only on main after tests
checklist.description: The deploy job has `needs:` on the test job and an `if:` limiting it to pushes on the main branch.

checklist.name: Job summary written
checklist.description: A step appends a short deployment summary to `$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY`.

checklist.name: Cleanup always runs
checklist.description: The temporary build directory is removed in a step guarded by `if: always()`.

checklist.name: Versions taken from reference
checklist.description: Pages and other public action versions come from the skill's common-actions reference or fetched documentation, not from memory.

checklist.name: Public action docs consulted
checklist.description: The agent looks up documentation for any public action not covered by the reference, using a search or Context7.

checklist.name: Actions SHA-pinned with comment
checklist.description: Every action is pinned to a full commit SHA followed by a version comment.

checklist.name: Minimal permissions
checklist.description: A top-level `permissions:` block is present and write scopes such as `pages` and `id-token` appear only on the deploy job.

checklist.name: Concurrency and timeouts
checklist.description: The workflow sets a concurrency group and every job sets `timeout-minutes:`.

checklist.name: Lowercase-hyphen file name
checklist.description: The workflow file name is lowercase with hyphens, for example `deploy-pages.yml`.

checklist.name: Validated before presenting
checklist.description: The agent runs the github-actions-validator skill, fixes errors and re-validates before presenting the workflow.
